content.short: Longbow is an RWA lending layer on Robinhood Chain for borrowing against tokenized stocks.
content.description: Longbow lets users lend USDG and borrow against tokenized equities and other real-world assets on Robinhood Chain. Borrowing against stock without selling it is an ordinary service in traditional brokerage, and reproducing it on-chain is among the more concrete reasons to tokenize equities in the first place.
